"""Verify strip_accents_unicode fix by AST-extracting the REAL function
from sklearn/feature_extraction/text.py (working tree vs git HEAD).
No repo files are modified; the package itself cannot be imported here
(unbuilt C extensions, Python 3.12 vs 2019 sklearn)."""
import ast, subprocess, sys, unicodedata

REPO = "C:/Users/agent/work/work/scikit-learn-15100-nopanel"
PATH = "sklearn/feature_extraction/text.py"


def extract(source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "strip_accents_unicode":
            mod = ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[])
            ns = {"unicodedata": unicodedata}
            exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(mod), PATH, "exec"), ns)
            return ns["strip_accents_unicode"]
    raise RuntimeError("function not found")


def get_src(rev):
    if rev == "worktree":
        with open(f"{REPO}/{PATH}") as f:
            return f.read()
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", f"{rev}:{PATH}"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def check(fn, label):
    # exact reproduction from the issue
    s1 = chr(241)                 # one code point: LATIN SMALL LETTER N WITH TILDE
    s2 = chr(110) + chr(771)      # two code points: n + COMBINING TILDE
    r1, r2 = fn(s1), fn(s2)
    print(f"[{label}] s1={s1!r} -> {r1!r}   s2={s2!r} -> {r2!r}")
    ok = (r1 == "n" and r2 == "n")
    # assertions equivalent to the repo's test_strip_accents (not modified)
    cases = [
        ('àáâãäåçèéêë', 'aaaaaaceeee'),
        ('ìíîïñòóôõöùúûüý', 'iiiinooooouuuuy'),
        ('\u0625', '\u0627'),
        ("this is à test", 'this is a test'),
    ]
    for a, expected in cases:
        got = fn(a)
        ok = ok and got == expected
        print(f"[{label}]   {a!r} -> {got!r} (expected {expected!r}) {'OK' if got == expected else 'FAIL'}")
    return ok


head_ok = check(extract(get_src("HEAD")), "HEAD (buggy)")
work_ok = check(extract(get_src("worktree")), "WORKTREE (fixed)")
print()
print("HEAD reproduces the issue (s2 unchanged):", not head_ok)
print("WORKTREE passes issue repro + test_strip_accents cases:", work_ok)
sys.exit(0 if (not head_ok and work_ok) else 1)
